specs.title: [ADM-01] sends guests to sign-in, forbids customers and lets admins in
[ADM-02] validates the new product form at its bounds and creates the product
[ADM-03] edits a product to its lower bounds and deletes a product
[ADM-04] allows only valid order status transitions
[AUTH-01] registers a new customer with normalized name and email
[AUTH-02] shows registration errors for every invalid field and a taken email
[AUTH-03] rejects invalid credentials and returns to the requested page after sign-in
[AUTH-04] signs out and drops the cart of the session
[CART-01] adds products and updates the header counter
[CART-02] enforces the per-line limit of 10 and the available stock
[CART-03] updates quantities, removes a line at zero and rejects invalid values
[CART-04] calculates line totals and the cart subtotal
[CART-05] warns about reduced stock and blocks checkout until the cart is fixed
[CAT-01] filters by category and stock availability
[CAT-02] includes products priced exactly at the range bounds

specs.title: [CAT-03] reports invalid price filters and resets a reversed range
[CAT-04] sorts by price and breaks price ties by name
[CAT-05] paginates by 8 products and keeps filters in page links
[CHK-01] validates every shipping field and accepts boundary values
[CHK-02] applies a percent promo code with rounding and keeps it on the order
[CHK-03] applies fixed and free-shipping promo codes (free shipping is standard only)
[CHK-04] rejects expired, inactive and unknown codes and blocks the order
[CHK-05] accepts a promo code at exactly the minimum order and rejects it below
[CHK-06] ships free from $50.00 after discount and always charges express
[CHK-07] places an order, decreases stock and empties the cart
[E2E-01] guest registers, finds a product, buys it with a promo code and sees it in the history
[E2E-02] admin moves a new order through its statuses and the customer sees each change
[ORD-01] lists the order history newest first, ties broken by id
[ORD-02] shows order details with amounts and hides other customers’ orders
[ORD-03] cancels a pending order and returns its items to stock
[PRD-01] shows in-stock, low-stock and out-of-stock badges around the threshold of 5
[PRD-02] disables adding an out-of-stock product to the cart
[PRD-03] shows product details and 404 for unknown or malformed ids
[SRCH-01] ranks prefix matches before word matches before inner matches
[SRCH-02] normalizes the query and requires at least 2 characters
[SRCH-03] shows an empty result for a query without matches
